home: No active run is required; review is component-based illustration only; opening never calls StartGame or energy/ads/results logic.
pause: Existing run stays paused while review is open; Close/Done returns to Pause settings, not Resume.
controls_preserved: All original settings and pause controls retain original art/positions/routes. Level Select remains Level Select, not silently Home.
language_list: While expanded, only its 2 options receive relevant selection. A click outside list closes only list and consumes the pointer. It cannot trigger newly exposed Help or underlying Resume/Restart/LevelSelect. Escape closes list before settings.
review_exit: Restore exact saved context. If run was externally replaced/destroyed, route through existing screen resolver; do not restart it or debit energy.
input_debounce: Disable repeat Open while viewer is opening or already exists; reuse one viewer instance; no duplicate modal stack.
button_states: Reuse existing normal/pressed/focus/disabled style specification from STATIC_NIGHT_STATE_SUPPLEMENT_v1. These are no new engine effects.
pending_state: If required guide assets are actually unavailable, keep existing settings active and show a short existing service/error label; never open blank fullscreen or remove original controls.
geometry: Use scenes_and_labels.json; all closed-mode target boxes pass44 logical px at360 and are pairwise disjoint. Expanded language only activates its option targets.
